data.standardized_narrative: The scanned report images provided limited legible detail for the specific gross prior-year reserve movement (prior year development). The balance sheet/technical provisions indicate a closing gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2015 of approximately GBP 135.758m (used here as opening reserves for 2016). The report pages available did not allow an unambiguous extraction of a gross prior-year movement figure or a definitive mapping of LOB-level reserve movements.
data.data_quality_notes: Scanned PDF images were partially rotated and of limited legibility. The closing gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2015 (used as opening reserves for 2016) was picked from the technical provisions/balance sheet table but the table structure and labels were not fully clear so confidence is moderate (0.5). No explicit, unambiguous GROSS prior-year development (movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding) line could be confidently located in the images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. The gross premiums written figure (198,979 GBP 000) was taken from the income statement but other supporting notes (segmental analysis and detailed technical reserves movement rows/notes) were not legible enough to extract reliably. Many requested fields (prior year movement, exact reserve-movement text, detailed LOB movements, claims triangle) could not be extracted from the provided images with high confidence.
